verdict.rationale: The evidence shows segmentation exists only as a 'Predictive Segmentation' item on the pricing page. Related signals are thin: purchase data can be synced via Magento for targeted emails, and click/open tracking records recipient behavior. Nothing describes building segments from profile attributes, tags, or events, or says that segments update automatically. Missing for 10: documented segment builder with attribute/tag/event conditions, evidence that segments stay live as data changes, tag-based targeting, independent or hands-on corroboration.
